reason: Check implementation against formats, algorithm steps, error matrix and every assertion listed in Tests required.
Acceptance criteria: full upstream content, update follows new commits, unreachable upstream keeps old version, no rewrites left, doctor shows source/version/license.
Contract conformance for §3 upstream skills and §7 skills view; UI one word per concept, no sentences, no wrapping.
Stable proof budgets unchanged after remote-git extraction; new scenario for upstream skills added with tests.
Verifier stays fail-closed: missing, extra, drifted, invalid lock or sources all produce stable categories.
Failed fetch or invalid sources never changes the active release or launchers; no half-published candidate.
Skills view wording and layout rules.
Doctor and server consume the same kernel view builder; no casts of raw lock JSON in UI or commands.
Kernel has no fs or network; files under the 500-line limit enforced by check:architecture.
CLI tests use injected runCommand and local git fixtures; no live network in unit tests.
